I.O. D.1203

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. C. D. 1203.
Date. 23...-..5..-..30.

May 22, 30.

Dear Blackburn,

With reference to your letter, dated
April 25, 1930, enclosing a copy of a letter
received from a Mr. John Hart, regarding the
whereabouts of his brother, I have to inform
you that careful enquiries have failed to reveal
any trace of Edward Henry Hart in Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,

A. D. Blackburn Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1930年5月22日。

亲爱的布莱克本：

关于您1930年4月25日的来信，信中附有一份来自约翰·哈特（John Hart）先生的信件副本，询问其兄弟的下落，特此告知，经仔细查访，未能在上海发现爱德华·亨利·哈特（Edward Henry Hart）的任何踪迹。

此致

敬礼

A. D. 布莱克本 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

Special Branch
(Foreign Section)

File No.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
May 20, 1930.

Sir,

Despite careful enquiries no trace of
Edward Henry Hart can be found in Shanghai.
All likely places such as the Hanbury
Institute, Savoy Hotel, Jimmys Kitchen and other
places frequented by seafaring men have been
visited, but Hart is unknown at either place.
Enquiries were also made at the Shipping
Office of the American Consulate, but without
result.

D. S. I.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

Reg.
Please draft reply to
Mr Blackburn giving the
above facts.
22.5.30.

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
1930年5月20日。

先生，

尽管进行了仔细查访，但在上海未能找到爱德华·亨利·哈特的任何踪迹。所有可能的地点，如汉伯里研究所（Hanbury Institute）、沙逊大厦萨沃伊饭店（Savoy Hotel）、吉米厨房（Jimmys Kitchen）以及其他海员常去的地方，均已走访，但上述各处均无人认识哈特。也曾向美国领事馆航运办事处查询，但无结果。

副督察长

分区督察
（刑事与特别分部）

登记
请草拟回复布莱克本先生的信函，告知上述事实。
1930年5月22日。

April 25. 1930.

My dear Aiers,

Will you be so good
as to ask among your people
whether anyone knows anything
about the man referred to

attached.

He is not registered here
or known to our Shipping Clerks.

Yours sincerely
W.D. Blackham.

pages.en:
British Consul
Shanghai, China.

Dear Sir:-

I am trying to trace my brother, who has been
missing since 1926-27. and I will deem it a great favor if you
can assist me in this search.

He was last heard of in Shanghai, during the Chinese
uprising, and if you can possibly discover his whereabouts,
kindly report to me, as I should like to pass the news on to
my parents, in England.

My brothers name is, Edward Henry ( Teddy ) Hart;
weight 150 lbs., height, 5 ft., 7 or 8 " fair hair, and
complexion, hazel-brown eyes. He has strong white regular
teeth, and is very broad of shoulder.

He is a very reckless and daring fellow, and
sometimes passed himself off as an Australian.

He was born in Bermondsey, London, in 1902.
Sailors from London, knew him well, but we have failed to
trace him here in New York.

Thanking you in advance for any trouble you may
have, I am most sincerely yours.

(Signed) John Hart

217 Quincy St.
Brooklyn, N.Y.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 1203.
Date..28...-..4..- 30.）
pages.zh:
英国领事
中国上海。

尊敬的先生：

我正在寻找我的兄弟，他自1926-27年起失踪。如果您能协助我进行此次搜寻，我将不胜感激。

最后一次听到他的消息是在上海，正值中国起义期间，如果您能设法查明他的下落，恳请告知，以便我将此消息转告我在英国的父母。

我兄弟的名字是爱德华·亨利（泰迪）·哈特；体重150磅，身高5英尺7或8英寸，金发，肤色浅褐，眼睛呈淡褐色。他牙齿洁白整齐且坚固，肩膀很宽。

他是一个极其鲁莽和大胆的人，有时冒充澳大利亚人。

他于1902年出生在伦敦伯蒙塞（Bermondsey）。伦敦的海员都很认识他，但我们在纽约未能追踪到他的下落。

预先感谢您为此付出的辛劳，我是您最真诚的。

（签名）约翰·哈特

纽约布鲁克林区
昆西街217号
